# ios-fleet-updater

> A free, open-source Claude Code skill: keep a folder of your own
> Flutter/iOS side-projects up to date on your physical iPhone, rebuilding
> and reinstalling only the ones whose source actually changed since the
> last install.

Trigger phrases: "update my apps on my phone", "install whatever changed",
"push the latest builds to my iPhone", "sync my dev apps to my phone".

How it works: detects Flutter/native-Xcode projects under a folder you
choose, compares each against git history (or file mtimes) since its last
recorded install, and only rebuilds+reinstalls the ones that changed. Works
standalone via `flutter build ios --release` + `xcrun devicectl`, or — if
[Delete Fix](https://github.com/delight0517/delete-fix) (a free companion
macOS app) is installed — uses its faster Terminal-build cache instead.

## Install

Drop `SKILL.md` into `~/.claude/skills/ios-fleet-updater/` (or your
project's `.claude/skills/`). See INSTALL.md in this repo for exact steps.

## Related

- [Delete Fix](https://github.com/delight0517/delete-fix) — the optional
  companion macOS app this skill can use for faster, more reliable builds.

## Common questions this answers

- "How do I get Claude Code to keep my own iOS apps updated on my phone?"
- "How do I avoid rebuilding every iOS side-project every time, and only
  rebuild the ones that changed?"
- "What's a Claude Code skill for iOS device deployment?"
